top_signals.title: Low Gas Storage and Diesel Shortages Threaten Europe’s Winter Supply
top_signals.summary: Tightening global supply of oil and gas is putting Europe on course for a difficult winter this year due to the continent’s significant dependence on energy imports, despite energy transition ambitions. Gas in storage is much lower than it should be, and a diesel crunch is threatening fuel oil supply security for the heating season. It could turn into a perfect storm.
